definitions.explanation: Aquatic animals with shells, such as clams and oysters.
The hard outer covering of shellfish.

notes:
{貝|かい} refers to both shellfish (the animal) and their shells.

TYPES OF SHELLFISH:
- ⟦{二枚貝|にまいがい}→二枚貝：23394_nimaigai⟧: bivalve (clams, mussels)
- ⟦{巻|ま}き{貝|がい}→巻き貝：23395_makigai⟧: gastropod, snail
- ⟦アサリ→アサリ：10207_asari⟧: short-neck clam
- ⟦ハマグリ→ハマグリ：23183_hamaguri⟧: hard clam
- ⟦{牡蠣|かき}→牡蠣：10786_kaki⟧: oyster
- ホタテ: scallop
